title: lineage
notes:
For a long time, Drakengard existed in the category of 'someday.'

Not because it was impossible to acquire, but because there was always something else competing for shelf space, budget, or attention. The older I get, the less interested I am in collecting everything and the more interested I am in collecting intentionally.

Drakengard matters because of what followed. The ideas, themes, and creative DNA that would eventually give rise to the NieR series all begin here. The games themselves are messy, difficult, and often deeply uncomfortable. They're also impossible to replace.

With the arrival of Drakengard, the lineage is complete.

Filed, preserved, and available whenever the archive calls for it.

— Dakota
